item.title: Shaheen: Machine Translation API
item.description:
Shaheen represents the machine translation arm of Arabic Language Technologies at QCRI. I’ve been involved in training SOTA models, as well as managing a distributed backend to serve multiple machine translation engines. Our API has served over 150 million requests from 40+ countries so far!

After serving a lot of customers, it is now part of the Fanar Platform, check us out there!
